CustomField.description: The scripted step this defect was raised against — the other half of the unification (2026-08-06). Before this, scripted defects lived only as Test_Step_Result__c.Defect_Severity__c / Defect_Summary__c and were not findings at all. SetNull because Test_Step_Result__c is master-detail to Test_Execution__c and gets purged with a cycle; the finding is the durable record and must outlive the run.
CustomField.label: Test Step Result
